user_journeys.name: configure-runtime-evidence
user_journeys.description: An operator working on a project (e.g. axiom, glam) declares which runtime evidence sources apply to their plans and supplies the per-source connection details. The operator runs `dontpanic project config` (or hand-edits per-project config) to set web base URLs, iOS simulator names, Android device serials / package IDs, backend provider configuration. Global config may carry agent roles (`roles.implementer / auditor / goal_auditor`) but never runtime-evidence target defaults (D015). All credential references are pointer-shaped (`adc`, `env:NAME`, path-only — D014); literal credential values are refused. After configuration, `dontpanic doctor` reports the runtime-evidence registration health for each declared source.
acceptance_signals: operator can set roles via `dontpanic config set roles.implementer claude` (and equivalent for auditor / goal_auditor)
operator can set per-project runtime-evidence sources via `dontpanic project config set runtime_evidence.<source>.<key> <value>` for any of the four capture surfaces

runtime_evidence config resolves with precedence per-call > project config > default-none (no global tier per D015); a per-call override beats project config, project config beats absence-of-config, and absence-of-config does NOT fall through to a global default
global config refuses `runtime_evidence.*` keys with an actionable error pointing at the project-config command
credential literals in config are refused; only pointer shapes (`adc`, `env:NAME`, path-only) are accepted
`dontpanic setup` is preview-by-default; mutation requires `--yes` for non-interactive consistency
`dontpanic doctor` reports per-source registration health (configured / missing / unhealthy with reason)

user_journeys.name: capture-web-evidence
user_journeys.description: During a feature close-out for a plan with web journeys, the operator invokes the web evidence collector against an operator-supplied base URL. The collector captures per-step screenshots + DOM snapshots + console errors + network failures, with optional trace + video honored when the operator requests them. The driver default is Playwright but the implementation exposes a swap seam for alternate drivers. Captured artifacts land at `evidence/goal-governance/post_impl/web/<journey-id>/<artifact>` per the D003 convention. The capture is project-agnostic — there is no project-name special-casing in the adapter or driver code.
acceptance_signals: screenshot artifact is written under `evidence/goal-governance/post_impl/web/<journey>/` for each captured step
DOM snapshot accompanies each screenshot
console-error and network-failure artifacts are captured per step
trace + video are captured when the operator requests them via per-call config
base URL is operator-supplied; no hardcoded URLs in adapter or driver code
driver is swappable behind a documented seam (Playwright is the default)
no project-name tokens (e.g. `spin_dine_*`, `glam_*`, `creator_hub_*`) appear in the web adapter source

user_journeys.name: capture-ios-evidence
user_journeys.description: During a feature close-out for a plan with iOS journeys, the operator invokes the iOS evidence collector against a configured simulator runtime. The collector drives `xcrun simctl` to capture per-step screenshots + simulator log slices + per-session crash reports. When no simulator runtime is available, the collector skips gracefully with a recorded reason rather than raising. The driver accepts a swappable simctl-runner for testing.
acceptance_signals: screenshot artifact is written under `evidence/goal-governance/post_impl/ios/<journey>/` for each captured step
simulator-log slice is captured per step or per session
crash-report artifact is drained per session (when crashes occurred)
no-simulator-available case produces a typed-skip evidence ref with operator-readable reason, NOT an exception
simctl-runner is swappable for testing; no hard dependency on a specific simulator device name in adapter code

user_journeys.name: capture-android-evidence
user_journeys.description: During a feature close-out for a plan with Android journeys, the operator chooses one of two capture-only modes (D009): `passive_observe` runs `adb screencap` / `logcat` slices / tombstone + ANR drains against an existing device or emulator the operator has already started; `post_hoc_ingest` consumes existing artifacts the operator's CI / test-runner already produced (Gradle / Espresso / Maestro output). DontPanic does NOT own Android test orchestration in v1 — the adapter explicitly refuses to spawn Gradle, Espresso runners, Maestro, or `am instrument`.
acceptance_signals: passive_observe mode captures screenshot + logcat slice + tombstone + ANR drain artifacts under `evidence/goal-governance/post_impl/android/<journey>/`
post_hoc_ingest mode consumes a caller-supplied artifact tree without re-orchestrating tests
operator selects the mode explicitly via per-call config; there is no implicit fallback between modes
the adapter source contains no test-orchestration tokens (`gradle`, `gradlew`, `espressoRunner`, `am instrument`, `maestro test`, `maestro studio`, `androidx.test.runner`)
no-device-available case produces a typed-skip evidence ref with operator-readable reason

user_journeys.name: capture-backend-evidence
user_journeys.description: During a feature close-out for a plan with backend journeys, the operator selects a backend provider (Firebase / Supabase / Generic) and the collector captures observability artifacts for the journey's time window. The Firebase provider reuses the F022 service-account path (no new credential storage per D005); Supabase ships as a provider slot with fixture tests only (no live auth in v1); the Generic provider accepts operator-supplied runtime credentials only via D014 pointer shapes. The adapter is provider-adapter based (D010) — no Firebase-specific assumptions appear in the common harness layer.
acceptance_signals: Firebase adapter fetches Cloud Logging + Crashlytics + Performance artifacts; reuses F022 SA path
Supabase adapter is registered as a provider slot; fixture tests cover the slot shape; no live Supabase auth in v1
Generic provider accepts HTTP / log-file / JSONL inputs via operator-supplied connection details
all credential references are pointer-shaped (`adc`, `env:NAME`, path-only); literal credentials are refused
the backend ABC + adapters live in the backend adapter layer; the common harness contains zero `firebase_*` / `supabase_*` / provider-specific tokens

user_journeys.name: compose-mixed-source-evidence
user_journeys.description: The common harness lets a feature close-out journey collect evidence from multiple source surfaces in one call. The operator invokes `EvidenceCollector.collect(journey, context, sources=[...])` with a list naming any subset of {web, ios, android, backend}; the harness composes the per-source adapters via a registry and returns a uniform `list[EvidenceRef]`. The harness is pure orchestration: zero source-specific logic in the core, no MCP wrap in v1 (library-only consumption by F2), uniform artifact path layout per D003. A typed-skip from one source must not abort the others.
acceptance_signals: `EvidenceCollector.collect(journey, context, sources=[...])` exists with the documented signature
the harness composes any subset of {web, ios, android, backend} per call
harness output is `list[EvidenceRef]` with uniform path layout `evidence/goal-governance/post_impl/<source>/<journey-id>/<artifact>`
the harness core contains zero source-specific tokens (web / ios / android / backend / firebase / supabase / playwright / simctl / adb / logcat / tombstone)
a typed-skip from one source does not prevent other sources from completing their captures
library-only consumption — no MCP tool wrap shipped in v1

non_goals: F2 audit semantics — Plan G ships capture only (D002); any assertion / scoring / journey-walk / completion-test logic belongs to F2 and is explicitly out of scope

Cross-vendor dogfood dispatcher — D006 queues the cross-vendor invariant as a separate follow-up plan; G is capture-only and does not engage the cross-vendor surface (this contract therefore does not require evidence of cross-vendor dispatch)
Android test orchestration — D009 makes G3 capture-only; the adapter must not spawn Gradle / Espresso / Maestro / `am instrument`
New credential storage — D005 + D014 forbid storing literal credential values anywhere DontPanic manages; only pointer shapes (`adc`, `env:NAME`, path-only) are permitted
Global runtime-evidence defaults — D015 makes runtime evidence project-scoped; global config may carry agent roles but never runtime target defaults
agent-conventions schema bump — D007 confirms EvidenceRef v1.4.0 type enum covers all G adapter outputs; no v1.5.0 bump (single-repo plan)
MCP tool wrap — locked at lock turn as a follow-up; G is library-only consumed by F2 in-process
Project-name special cases in adapter code — D004 (inherited from F1 D013): no `spin_dine_*` / `glam_*` / `creator_hub_*` tokens anywhere in adapters or harness core
completion_test: Plan G is complete when an operator working on any project (regardless of stack composition) can: (1) configure agent roles globally and runtime-evidence sources per-project via the config surface, with credential pointers only and `dontpanic doctor` reporting per-source health; (2) capture per-step screenshots + per-session logs + crash artifacts on web, iOS, and Android during a feature close-out, with graceful typed-skip when a runtime is unavailable; (3) capture provider-adapted backend observability artifacts via Firebase / Supabase-slot / Generic providers with operator-supplied credential pointers; (4) compose any subset of those four source surfaces via `EvidenceCollector.collect(journey, context, sources=[...])` and receive a uniform `list[EvidenceRef]` with a stable artifact path layout under `evidence/goal-governance/post_impl/<source>/<journey-id>/`; (5) verify by inspection that the harness core and adapters contain no project-name special cases and no test-orchestration tokens (Android), and that the EvidenceRef shape matches agent-conventions v1.4.0 without requiring a schema bump. Empty findings against this contract means 'Plan G's promise is materially captured by the runtime evidence harness'; per F2 D002 it does NOT mean 'every adapter is bug-free' — only that the goal-completion surface is intact at the v1 evidence-coverage heuristic level.
